title: Prove deliberate issue-sync opt-in in installed setup
text: Source regressions cover shared setup leaving sync off, explicit enable permissions and issue-creation links. The existing installer campaign must prove terminal setup stays silent, relevant agent guidance offers a separate opt-in, permission refusal teaches recovery, and the first created issue notice links to the issue. Keep the existing campaign owner, approval and readiness holds; this candidate needs its own admitted execution and cannot borrow frozen-run credit.
